title: Old Reichsbank notes and new Rentenbank notes, selected month ends
series: million rentenmark-equivalent, old paper marks divided by 10^12; end-month stocks
license: Bresciani-Turroni (1937, 'ALL RIGHTS RESERVED'): a factual transcription of three month-end stocks, with credit to the author; no text is reproduced.
notes: The original English edition uses British trillion=10^18, not modern American trillion=10^12. 496 British trillion paper marks /10^12 =496 million rentenmark-equivalent. Notes only, excludes deposits, private emergency currency and foreign money. Two issuing banks must be added; no reading of this as the whole money stock. The copy read is listed under documents (with its SHA-256); the rows hold no quotations, so data/fetch/verify_web_quotes.py does not read this snapshot.

bresciani1937.version: The Economics of Inflation, translated by Millicent E. Sayers, London: George Allen & Unwin, 1937; revised English edition. OCR of scan, print pages as specified. British billion=10^12, trillion=10^18.
